name: RezBot
tagline: Finds an open table and makes the restaurant booking for you
description: Say where you want to eat, or just roughly what you are in the mood for, and it goes looking for a table that fits. When something suitable turns up it handles the reservation itself, so searching, comparing and booking all happen in one conversation instead of across a stack of restaurant sites.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
